summary: Iteration 4 focused on the operator-account-creation bug fix, driver widget, and dashboard rebuilds. BACKEND: 47/47 pytest pass (44 regression + 3 new /tests/test_operator_auth.py covering: register operator via /api/auth/register -> /auth/me returns role=operator, subsequent /auth/login succeeds with same email+password, admin sees the user in /admin/users and a lead(source=operator_signup); operator-registration + POST /interest produces both an interests row and a lead(source=operator_interest), and login continues to work; wrong password returns 401). Backend supports role=operator on register and stores password_hash so /operator-login works — key bug fix confirmed. FRONTEND (Playwright, live URL): /list-your-fleet estimator-monthly reads and updates on estimator-class-executive and estimator-slider (£9,393 -> £11,813 -> £22,450). Completed 3-step operator form (int-company, int-continue, int-areas, int-continue, int-name, int-role, int-email, int-phone, int-password >=6, int-submit) -> interest-success visible; interest-goto-dashboard navigates to /operator-dashboard where fleet-map is visible along with all op-tab-{overview,tracking,fleet,applications,financials,compliance}; fleet-map is also rendered on the tracking tab; body contains 'Live vehicle', 'Compliance', 'Revenue', 'Fleet' copy. THEN logged out and signed in at /operator-login with SAME email+password (oplogin-email/oplogin-password/oplogin-submit) — landed on /operator-dashboard with fleet-map visible. Driver widget: driver-takehome-value updates on driver-hours-part (£190 -> £122) and driver-car-executive (£122 -> £121). Driver 3-step registration (reg-name/reg-email/reg-phone/reg-continue/reg-password/reg-continue/reg-dvla/reg-pco/reg-submit) redirects to /portal; portal-hero, portal-documents, portal-compliance, portal-saved-card, portal-find-car all visible on the bento grid (my-applications not rendered when applications list is empty — empty state is shown instead, which matches spec). Regression: /admin login OK with admin@caro.co.uk/CaroAdmin2026!, Traction Dashboard renders growth chart (14-day), KPI cards (Total leads 106, Driver accounts 42, Operators 22, Cities 11), Leads/Applications/Interests/Users/Events tables, export-csv-btn present. Home + /search navigation works. No pageerrors during the runs; a few benign 401/404 console messages seen only when auth had not yet initialised or /auth/me pre-login.

minor.issue: No server-side min-length check on password (frontend enforces >=6). Returns 200 for short passwords. Recommend adding Pydantic min_length=6 to align with UI contract.

issues: Framer-motion opacity animations on bento cards make the cards briefly invisible on first paint — needs ~1s to become visible. Not a bug, but tests must add a small wait after navigation. Consider setting `initial={{opacity:1}}` or shorter transition for perceived snappiness.

action_items: (LOW) Add Pydantic min_length=6 to RegisterBody.password so backend rejects short passwords consistently with the UI.
(Carried from iter3) Home.jsx horizontal overflow at 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /auth/register accepts role in ('driver','operator') and creates password_hash — good, this is what unblocks /operator-login.

OperatorInterest.jsx: correctly calls AuthContext.register (role=operator) BEFORE POST /interest — this means an operator-user + a lead(source=operator_signup) + an interests row + a lead(source=operator_interest) are all created in a single flow. Verified via /admin/users, /admin/interests, /admin/leads.
AnimatedNumber now forwards data-testid to a text-bearing span — estimator-monthly and driver-takehome-value are readable via text_content and update reactively.
OperatorDashboard.jsx tracking tab reuses the same fleet-map data-testid — Playwright's is_visible against fleet-map returns True on both tabs.
No server-side password length validation — see minor backend issue.
